packet.title: EXI guardrails: oracle, golden corpus, ratchet, gate script
packet.summary: Builds the deterministic checks every later packet must pass: the exi_oracle, the golden corpus of tests/exi, the driver exi_golden with its exi_ratchet, and tools/exi/check-packet.sh.

item.p: Owns: new tools/exi-oracle/, tests/exi/, tools/exi/check-packet.sh; the registration in tests/CMakeLists.txt.
Done when: exi/golden-self-check passes (the comparison tells equal documents from different ones), exi/golden runs every case, and the gate script passes on the tree.
